title: Đây có phải là điểm đón phù hợp không?
englishTitle: Is this the right pickup point?
pronunciation: Day co phai la diem don phu hop khong
summary: For checking a pickup spot before you wait in the wrong place.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Airport doors, bus bays, hotel entrances, and tour pickups can have several nearby points that look correct.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Show the app, ticket, or message and point to where you are standing.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Đây có phải là asks is this; điểm đón is pickup point; phù hợp means right or suitable; không? checks it.

breakdown.vietnamese: Đây có phải là điểm đón phù hợp không?
breakdown.english: Is this the right pickup point

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: If the point is wrong, ask where to meet the driver, which entrance, or where the pickup area is.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good before a Grab, shuttle, tour, bus, ferry, or hotel-arranged car.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: A small walk can move you from the wrong curb to the correct pickup lane. Confirm before the driver arrives.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Use driver, entrance, pickup area, stop-here, or route follow-ups if the spot needs to change.
